all.source_quote: The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Castes/Neo-Buddhist category.

unmodelled.text: Must have lived in Maharashtra for at least 15 years
unmodelled.source_quote: The applicant must have resided in Maharashtra for at least 15 years.

unmodelled.text: Must own land or a temporary house
unmodelled.source_quote: The beneficiary must own land/a temporary house.

unmodelled.text: Must not have received a house under any other housing scheme
unmodelled.source_quote: The beneficiary should not have availed of any other housing scheme previously.

unmodelled.text: Must not be on the SECC-2011 priority list (those families are covered by other housing schemes)
unmodelled.source_quote: The beneficiary should be outside the priority list criteria of the Social, Economic, and Caste Census-2011 (SECC-2011).

unmodelled.text: Protected hutment dwellers on government land (as of 1.01.1995) need not submit the 7/12 land extract
unmodelled.source_quote: the requirement to submit 7/12 extract has been relaxed

unmodelled.text: Family income limit depends on the area: Rs 1.20 lakh in rural and hill/Naxal-affected areas, Rs 3.00 lakh in municipal councils and corporations

ambiguous: Neo-Buddhist applicants are eligible too, but the app has no Neo-Buddhist category, so they must answer SC (Buddhists are in the SC order since 1990; this page does not say so)
The income limit depends on rural or urban area, and the app has no such field, so it is not modelled
The table does not say whether the income limit is per year; read as annual family income

en.title: Ramai Awas Yojana (Rural and Urban)
en.benefit: Help to build a house: Rs 1.32 lakh rural, Rs 1.42 lakh hill/Naxal areas, Rs 2.50 lakh urban (beneficiary pays 7.5% to 10% in urban areas).
en.how_to_apply: Contact the Assistant Commissioner of Social Welfare of your district.
